grammar_focus: 现在完成时(have/has + 过去分词:结果、经历、刚完成;just/ever/never/yet)vs 现在完成进行时(have/has been + doing:动作从过去持续到现在;for/since/up till now),外加动词 + sth + to sb(explain/describe/say/suggest sth to sb)与 worth + 名词/doing(值得)(原创承载 NCE3 L4 考点·美国人 Danny 瞒着妻子当垃圾清运工)
scene: 如今,干体力活的人往往比坐办公室的人挣得多得多。可即便如此,很多人还是向往一份“白领”工作,情愿牺牲高薪,只为享受穿衬衫、打领带上班这份体面。这种奇怪的念头会闹出笑话。就说我邻居 Danny。他给一家大公司当垃圾清运工,已经干了两年,挣得很不错。只有一个问题:他从没跟妻子说过实话。结婚那天,他不好意思把真正的工作解释给她听,只说自己“在公司上班”。那两年他每天的套路都一样:早上穿件干净衬衫出门,拐个弯换上工作服,在垃圾车上干八个小时;回家前冲个澡,再把衬衫换回来。工友们直到现在都替他保守着秘密,妻子也一次都没发现。可情况刚刚变了:Danny 终于找到一份市中心的办公室工作。他只能挣一半的钱,却觉得地位的提升很值这份损失。从今往后,人们会叫他“Reyes 先生”,而不是“Danny”。

grammar_card.title: 两种“到现在”的时态:现在完成时 & 现在完成进行时
grammar_card.intro: ①现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词——强调到现在为止的结果、经历、刚刚完成(His wife has never found out. / Danny has just taken a new job.),常配 just、ever、never、yet、already。②现在完成进行时 have/has been + doing——强调一个动作从过去一直持续到现在(He has been working here for two years.),常配 for、since、up till now、all day。再记两个难点:③explain / describe / say / suggest 这类词,说“(把某事)对某人……”时要加 to(explain the job to her,不能说 explain her the job);④worth + 名词 / worth + doing = 值得(worth the loss / worth seeing)。

rows: 到现在的结果、经历、刚完成
She has never found out. / He has just left.
现在完成进行时 have/has been doing
动作从过去持续到现在
He has been working here for two years.
He explained the job to her.
It is well worth the loss. / worth seeing

specialRules.rule: 现在完成进行时更看重“一直在做”的过程(常配 for/since);现在完成时更看重“已经做完/做过”的结果或经历(常配 just/ever/never/yet)。
explain / describe / say / suggest 后面说“对某人”要加 to(explain the plan to me),不能像 give 那样直接说 explain me the plan。
美语里“垃圾清运工”常说 garbage collector(英式 dustman);“白领”white-collar 指坐办公室的脑力劳动者,“蓝领”blue-collar 指体力劳动者。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is Danny's real job?
options: A garbage collector for a corporation

passage: These days, people who do manual work often earn far more than people who sit in offices. Even so, many workers still dream of a 'white-collar' job, and they will gladly sacrifice higher pay just for the privilege of wearing a shirt and tie to work. This strange idea can lead to some funny situations. Take my neighbor Danny. He has been working as a garbage collector for a large corporation for two years now, and he earns very good money. There is only one problem: he has never told his wife the truth. On their wedding day, he was too embarrassed to explain his real job to her, so he simply said that he worked 'for the Corporation.' For two years his routine was always the same. Every morning he left home in a clean shirt, changed into his overalls around the corner, and spent eight hours on the trucks. Before coming home, he took a quick shower and put the shirt back on. His fellow workers have kept his secret up till now, and his wife has never once found out. But things have just changed. Danny has finally taken an office job downtown. He will earn only half as much, yet he feels the rise in status is well worth the loss. From now on, people will call him 'Mr. Reyes,' not 'Danny.'

stage5.stem: "That old movie is not ___ watching twice."(表示“值得做某事”,用哪个词)
